levels.cloud_content:
# One sandbox, four team ServiceDesk instances

Open the topology console for your assigned attacker VM. Linux login: `user-access / ClientLab-Only-2026!`. Each attacker VM hosts a separate ServiceDesk instance on port 8080, with its own database: attacker1 `http://10.80.0.11:8080/`, attacker2 `http://10.80.0.12:8080/`, attacker3 `http://10.80.0.13:8080/`, attacker4 `http://10.80.0.14:8080/`. From the school LAN through the Windows gateway, use ports 8011, 8012, 8013, and 8014 respectively on `10.13.145.42`. Login username is `alice`; find your generated password in `~/lab-addresses.txt` on your assigned VM. The Kali identity pages remain on port 80. The shared ServiceDesk server at `10.80.0.20` remains isolated from attacker VMs. Keep this level open during the lab. Enter `finish-sqli-lab` only when done. Search inside ServiceDesk is the SQL injection exercise.
levels.local_content: This lab is designed for a CyberRangeCZ cloud sandbox. Open its assigned Training Instance.
